fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.body:
Induction hob (Ikea). The two left burners display a flashing « U » if your pan diameter is too small: use larger pans or the right burner, which works with smaller containers.

Microwave, oven, dishwasher (tablets provided), kettle, and everything you need (pans, frying pans, utensils).
fields.amenities.2.title: Kitchen
fields.amenities.3.sub: Nespresso machine — capsules provided on first night
fields.amenities.3.title: Coffee
fields.amenities.4.body:
A sofa bed is available in the living room. Sheets are in the cupboard under the TV, and duvets are in the sofa's storage compartment.

Sleeping arrangements: 2 double beds (160×200) + the sofa bed. A travel cot is available on request before arrival.
fields.amenities.4.title: Sofa bed
fields.amenities.5.body:
The washing machine in the kitchen has a drying function. It automatically shuts off from 8pm to 8am to keep the peace for neighbours (a child's bedroom is directly below).

A second Samsung condenser dryer (16 kg) is available for cleaning, but you can use it if needed.
fields.amenities.5.title: Washer-dryer
fields.amenities.6.body:
Winter — radiators with thermostat set to 20 °C (automatic cutoff above). Inactive in summer.

Summer — portable air conditioner on the mezzanine. For best performance: lower the Velux blinds, open opposite windows to create airflow, and give the unit time to cool things down.
fields.amenities.6.title: Heating & air conditioning
fields.amenities.7.body:
The electrical panel is on the landing, outside the apartment, in the cupboard on the left.

Check that all small switches are on and the main round button is set to 1. Unplug large appliances before resetting if it trips again.
fields.amenities.7.title: Electrical panel

fields.parking.summary: Pedestrian street: quick drop-off in front of the building, then nearby parking.
fields.parking.text.0: 🅿️ Marché des Beaux-Arts Parking — covered and secure, 500 m away (5 min walk). Around €1.90/night (valid from 7pm to 9am).
fields.parking.text.1: 🆓 Robelin and Battant Parking — free, under the ramparts, less than 10 min walk. Search « Parking Robelin » or « Parking Battant » on Maps.
fields.parking.text.2: Rue des Granges is pedestrian: unload quickly in front of the building (no extended parking), then move your car.
fields.recos.food.0.desc: Stunning Art Deco brasserie from 1850, at 31 rue des Granges — right at the foot of the building. The setting alone is worth the visit, with well-executed bistro cuisine. Reservation recommended.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: Chic bistro celebrating Bourgogne-Franche-Comté terroir in a historic Conservatoire building. Maison Bernard Loiseau. 27 rue des Boucheries.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: Seasonal menu with Asian influences, great vegetarian options. 1 rue Megevand. 03 81 50 10 20.
fields.recos.food.3.desc: All the cheese specialities of Franche-Comté: cancoillotte (a creamy cheese spread), croûte forestière (a local cheese dish), Comté-Morbier fondue, tartiflette. 82 rue Battant. Reservation recommended.
fields.recos.food.4.desc: Fine dining table by chef Francesco di Marzio, fusion cuisine overlooking Parc Micaud and the Doubs river. A lovely experience for a special dinner.
fields.recos.food.5.desc: Local specialities and lasagnes at reasonable prices, in a vintage setting with checked tablecloths. 28 rue Claude Pouillet. 03 81 82 35 09.
fields.recos.food.6.desc: A little gem in Haut-Battant: generous, beautifully presented dishes, local Franche-Comté produce. 7 rue Richebourg.
fields.recos.food.7.desc: Traditional French cuisine, renowned for its Comté fondue. 17 avenue Elisée Cusenier.
fields.recos.shop.0.desc: At 47 rue de Vesoul. Attentive staff. In case of emergency outside opening hours, the on-call service details are posted in the window.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: Vauban's masterpiece, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Spanning 12 hectares, it houses three museums (Comtois, Resistance and Deportation, Museum with aquarium).
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: Lunch cruise (~2 hours) or dinner cruise (~2.5 hours) with commentary: lock passages and tunnel under the Citadel. Upper deck terrace. Departure from Pont de la République. Reservation required.
fields.transport.lines.0.text: Nearest stop at Place de la Révolution. Pay by card directly on board for a single journey.
